newsitem.title: INDIA: Foreign funds turn net sellers on Bombay bourse.
newsitem.headline: Foreign funds turn net sellers on Bombay bourse.

text.p: Foreign insitutional investors (FIIs) registered on the Bombay bourse were net sellers at the end of October, according to the latest data available from the exchange.

Daily figures released by the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) show that FIIs sold shares totalling 500 million rupees in the last three days of October and bought shares totalling just 240 million during the period.
FIIs were net sellers on all three days.
